title: VisionSIM: Beyond Idealized Sensors - A Multi-Modal Simulator for Robot Perception
abstract: arXiv:2611.08368v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robotic perception increasingly relies on heterogeneous sensor suites combining cameras with emerging modalities (event, SPAD, iToF/dToF, and thermal). Yet existing simulators idealize these sensors, hiding critical modality-specific failure modes that limit real-world deployment. We present VisionSIM, a unified, physically grounded simulation platform that elevates sensor realism to a first-class concern by modeling the raw physical measurement process for diverse conventional and emerging modalities. We expose fine-grained control over physical sensor parameters, reproducing failure modes overlooked by general-purpose simulators: pileup and glare for LiDAR; phase wrapping, saturation, and motion artifacts for iToF; refractory drops for event cameras; and history-dependent emission for thermal cameras. translated_title: VisionSIM：超越理想化传感器——面向机器人感知的多模态模拟器
translated_abstract: 机器人感知日益依赖于将相机与新兴模态（事件相机、SPAD、iToF/dToF 和热成像）相结合的异构传感器组合。然而，现有模拟器将这些传感器理想化，掩盖了限制真实世界部署的关键的模态特定失效模式。我们提出 VisionSIM，一个统一的、基于物理的仿真平台，通过为多种传统和新兴模态建模原始物理测量过程，将传感器真实性提升为一等关注点。我们提供对物理传感器参数的细粒度控制，重现了被通用模拟器忽视的失效模式：LiDAR 的堆积效应与眩光；iToF 的相位缠绕、饱和与运动伪影；事件相机的不应期丢失；以及热成像相机依赖历史的发射特性。这使得在相同场景和轨迹上进行有原则的跨模态比较成为可能。我们发布了该平台以及一个大型室内数据（集，摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 提出 VisionSIM，一个基于物理的多模态传感器仿真平台，通过建模原始物理测量过程重现 LiDAR、iToF、事件相机和热成像等传感器的真实失效模式，支持在相同场景下的跨模态系统性比较与机器人感知研究。
